rules.text: Ignore dark, elongated shadows or debris-like shapes on the road surface if they are consistent with low-light conditions or road texture.
rules.justification: The agent falsely identified dark road textures and shadows as physical debris or obstacles. In low-light or high-contrast scenes, these visual artifacts are common and should be tolerated as normal.

rules.text: Do not flag pedestrians standing on sidewalks or near curbs as road obstacles unless they are clearly stepping into the active driving lane.
rules.justification: The agent misclassified pedestrians on the sidewalk (D12_0054) and parked cars (D12_0064) as anomalies. These are standard urban features and do not constitute road obstacles unless they encroach on the drivable path.

rules.text: Treat bright reflections, billboards, or light bars on vehicles as normal environmental features rather than defects or anomalies.
rules.justification: The agent flagged a billboard reflection and license plate illumination as anomalies. These are expected visual elements in night driving and should not be treated as road defects.
